rules.name: UseConsistentNaming
rules.message: Use snake_case for resource names
rules.example: Correct: 'resource_name'. Incorrect: 'ResourceName' or 'resource-Name'.

rules.name: IncludeDescription
rules.message: Include a description for each resource
rules.example: Correct: 'description = "This is a description for the resource"'.

rules.name: UseDataSources
rules.message: Use data sources where appropriate instead of hardcoding values
rules.example: Correct: 'data "aws_ami" "example" {...}' instead of hardcoded AMI IDs.

rules.name: UseModules
rules.message: Use modules to organize and reuse code
rules.example: Correct: 'module "vpc" { source = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws" ... }'.

rules.name: LimitResourceCount
rules.message: Consider using 'for_each' instead of 'count' for better modularity
rules.example: Correct: 'for_each = var.resources'.

rules.name: EnforceEncryption
rules.message: Ensure resources are encrypted where applicable
rules.example: Correct: 'encrypted = true' for S3 buckets, RDS instances, etc.

rules.name: UseSecureProtocols
rules.message: Use secure protocols (HTTPS) where applicable
rules.example: Correct: 'protocol = "https"' for web resources.

rules.name: RestrictPublicAccess
rules.message: Restrict public access to resources unless necessary
rules.example: Correct: 'public_access = false' for storage accounts.

rules.name: RequireTags
rules.message: Include tags for better resource management
rules.example: Correct: 'tags = { Environment = "prod" }'.

rules.name: UseIAMRoles
rules.message: Use IAM roles for access control instead of access keys
rules.example: Correct: 'iam_role = "role_name"' instead of storing access keys in code.

rules.name: EnforceResourceNaming
rules.message: Follow consistent resource naming conventions
rules.example: Correct: 'name = "resource-name"'. Incorrect: 'name = "ResourceName"'.

rules.name: AvoidLongRunningProcesses
rules.message: Avoid long-running processes; consider using asynchronous operations
rules.example: Avoid: 'long_running_process = true' where async tasks can be used.

rules.name: OptimizeDatabaseQueries
rules.message: Avoid using SELECT *; specify columns to optimize database queries
rules.example: Correct: 'SELECT id, name FROM users' instead of 'SELECT * FROM users'.

rules.name: ImplementErrorLogging
rules.message: Ensure error logging is implemented for better debugging
rules.example: Correct: 'log_error($error_message)' to capture errors.

rules.name: HandleExceptions
rules.message: Ensure exceptions are handled properly to prevent application crashes
rules.example: Correct: 'try { ... } catch { ... }' for handling exceptions.

rules.name: UseComments
rules.message: Use comments to explain complex logic and improve code readability
rules.example: Correct: '// This function handles user authentication'.

rules.name: UpdateDocumentation
rules.message: Ensure all TODOs related to documentation are addressed
rules.example: Correct: 'TODO: update documentation for new API endpoint'.

rules.name: AvoidHardcodedDependencies
rules.message: Avoid hardcoding dependencies; use a dependency management tool
rules.example: Correct: Use 'terraform { required_providers { ... } }' instead of hardcoded versions.

rules.name: UpdateDependencies
rules.message: Ensure dependencies are updated to the latest stable versions
rules.example: Correct: 'version = "1.2.3"'.

rules.name: ValidateUserInput
rules.message: Ensure user inputs are validated to prevent errors and improve UX
rules.example: Correct: Validate 'input { type = "string" }' to prevent invalid input types.

rules.name: ProvideFeedback
rules.message: Provide user feedback for actions to enhance user experience
rules.example: Correct: 'alert("Form submitted successfully!")' after successful form submission.
